identity.description: Bayesian nonparametric kernel model: a Gaussian prior over functions, conditioned exactly on the data. Its defining virtue is NATIVE uncertainty — every regression prediction is a full posterior N(μ,σ²), with σ honestly inflating away from the data. Its defining gate is cost: exact inference inverts the n×n kernel matrix, O(n³) time / O(n²) memory, ceiling ≈ 10k rows.

emits.note: regression predict returns the full posterior (mean, std) — the score port carries only μ and DROPS the native σ; portTypeProposal: 'predictive-distribution' (per-row mean+std/quantiles) so the uncertainty survives composition
classification — the latent GP is squashed through a Laplace-approximated posterior; probabilities are principled but approximate

kernel.note: kernel FORM is the hyperparameter; the length-scales/amplitudes inside it are optimized by maximizing the log marginal likelihood during fit

alpha.note: GPR only — diagonal jitter/noise added to the kernel; doubles as numerical stabilizer and observation-noise floor

n_restarts_optimizer.note: L-BFGS restarts against multimodal marginal likelihood; more restarts = more robust, linearly more fit cost

normalize_y.note: GPR only — centers/scales the target so the zero-mean prior is honest

max_iter_predict.note: GPC only — Newton iterations for the Laplace approximation

invariances.why: RBF/Matern kernels are distance-based with learned length-scales; unscaled features force the marginal-likelihood optimization to reconcile incomparable units, and a shared length-scale is dominated by the widest feature
kernel distances depend on actual coordinates — a monotone transform reshapes the kernel matrix and the entire posterior
kernel evaluation on a missing coordinate is undefined; sklearn raises on NaN
stationary kernels need numeric coordinates; categoricals must be encoded first
the model IS its distributional assumption — a Gaussian prior over functions with Gaussian observation noise; the celebrated σ is only honest insofar as that prior and noise model hold
THE defining gate: exact inference requires the Cholesky of the n×n kernel matrix — O(n³) time, O(n²) memory; beyond ~10k rows fit is impractical and the family must be gated out, not tuned

with stationary kernels the posterior mean reverts to the prior mean away from the data — but uniquely, the model SAYS so: σ inflates back to the prior variance, the native out-of-range warning no other family in this tranche emits

featureStats.why: the O(n³)/O(n²) exact-inference wall makes row count the single decisive statistic for this family — check it before anything else
length-scale optimization conditions badly over incomparable units — a large variance ratio predicts optimizer failure before it happens
stationary kernels suffer distance concentration in high dimension — past a few dozen dense features the covariance structure flattens and the GP loses its resolution

modelMetrics.why: the native model-evidence scoreboard the kernel search itself maximizes — directly comparable across kernel forms on the same data, no CV needed
the whole point of a GP is honest σ — empirical coverage of the nominal 95% interval is the direct test that the uncertainty is real and not just decorative

a length-scale pinned at its lower bound means the GP is interpolating noise; pinned at the upper bound means the feature is effectively ignored — both are misfit signatures read straight off the fitted kernel

edgeCases.note: route to gradient-boosting or linear families; sparse/inducing-point GPs are out of this driver's scope

edgeCases.condition: duplicate inputs with different targets and alpha≈0
edgeCases.behavior: kernel matrix numerically singular — Cholesky fails
edgeCases.note: raise alpha or include a WhiteKernel term

edgeCases.condition: marginal-likelihood optimizer converges to a bound

edgeCases.behavior: distance concentration flattens the covariance — posterior reverts to prior almost everywhere
amplitude collapses; σ dominated by noise term

driver.constructor: GaussianProcessRegressor(kernel=..., alpha=..., normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=2) / GaussianProcessClassifier(kernel=...), selected by problem_type
driver.wrapperNeeds: kernel spec string → kernel object construction; regression predict called with return_std=True and σ surfaced alongside μ
driver.serializationNote: artifact embeds the training X plus the Cholesky factor — size scales O(n²); acceptable only because the family is gated to small n

canBeSeeds.note: with a predictive-distribution port, the σ would be a second, highly informative stacking feature — today it is dropped

placementClaims.why: no native NaN handling — kernel evaluation is undefined on missing coordinates
stationary kernels model smooth, roughly homogeneous variation — symmetrizing skewed inputs (and normalize_y on the target) makes the stationarity assumption more nearly true
scale-sensitive by mechanism — length-scale optimization over unscaled units is ill-conditioned and a shared length-scale is meaningless across incomparable ranges
categoricals must be numeric before a stationary kernel can measure distance over them
